title: Rush
subtitle: 趕快；匆忙前往；加快行動
description: 趕快；匆忙前往；加快行動

words.meaning: 趕快；匆忙前往；加快行動
words.note: hurry 是 rush 最直接、最常見的近義詞之一，表示因時間不足或情況緊急而加快行動。它可表示趕路，也可表示匆忙做事。
words.example: We need to hurry if we want to catch the last train.
words.exampleZh: 如果我們想趕上尾班車，就得快一點。

exercises.original: We had to rush to the station because the last train was leaving in ten minutes.
exercises.zh: 因為尾班車十分鐘後就要開，我們只好趕往車站。
exercises.upgrade: hurry · 趕快；匆忙前往；加快行動

options.explanation: wander = 漫遊。沒有緊迫感，和 ten minutes left 不符。
hurry = 趕快。時間所剩不多，需要加快前往車站，是最自然的替換。
pause = 暫停。和 rush 相反。
stroll = 悠閒散步。和趕車不符。
linger = 逗留。和緊急趕路相反。

exercises.original: Don't rush through breakfast; you still have plenty of time.
exercises.zh: 不要匆忙吃完早餐；你還有很多時間。
exercises.upgrade: hurry · 趕快；匆忙前往；加快行動

options.explanation: enjoy = 享受。不是『匆忙完成』。
delay = 延遲。不是 rush 的意思。
finish carefully = 小心完成。和匆忙相反。
slow down = 放慢。是勸告內容，但不是原句 rush 的同義替換。
hurry = 匆忙。hurry through a meal/task 是自然搭配。
relax = 放鬆。不是 rush 本身。

exercises.original: She rushed home when she heard that her child was ill.
exercises.zh: 她聽到孩子生病後，立刻趕回家。
exercises.upgrade: hurry · 趕快；匆忙前往；加快行動

options.explanation: hurry = 趕快前往。urgent family news 是典型 hurry home 語境。
wander = 漫遊。沒有目的性與緊迫感。
pause = 暫停。無法表達趕回家。

words.meaning: 加快；趕緊；迅速前往（較正式）
words.note: hasten 比 hurry 正式，可表示自己趕快行動，也可表示使某個過程加快。常見於 hasten to do something / hasten the process。
words.example: She hastened to correct the misunderstanding.

exercises.original: The minister rushed to clarify his remarks before the story spread further.
exercises.zh: 部長在事件進一步傳開前，趕緊澄清自己的言論。
exercises.upgrade: hastened · 加快；趕緊；迅速前往（較正式）

options.explanation: waited = 等待。和 before the story spread further 的緊迫性相反。
paused = 暫停。不是趕緊澄清。
hastened = 趕緊。hasten to clarify 是較正式、自然的搭配。

exercises.original: Extra staff were brought in to rush the approval process.
exercises.zh: 增派人手是為了加快審批流程。
exercises.upgrade: hasten · 加快；趕緊；迅速前往（較正式）

options.explanation: hasten = 加快。hasten a process 是非常自然的正式用法。
cancel = 取消。不是速度變化。

exercises.original: He rushed to reassure everyone that the problem was under control.
exercises.zh: 他趕緊向大家保證問題已受控制。
exercises.upgrade: hastened · 加快；趕緊；迅速前往（較正式）

options.explanation: paused = 暫停。不是迅速回應。
hastened = 趕緊。hasten to reassure 是自然正式表達。

words.meaning: 趕快；速速行動（較正式／傳統）
words.note: make haste 是較正式、較傳統的片語，表示『趕快、別耽擱』。現代日常口語較常用 hurry，但 make haste 在書面、戲劇或較傳統語氣中仍自然。
words.example: We must make haste before the weather worsens.
words.exampleZh: 我們必須在天氣惡化前趕快行動。

exercises.original: We must rush if we want to reach the village before dark.
exercises.zh: 如果我們想在天黑前抵達村莊，就必須趕快。
exercises.upgrade: make haste · 趕快；速速行動（較正式／傳統）

options.explanation: make haste = 趕快。before dark 帶有明確時間壓力，且語氣適合較傳統表達。
wander = 漫遊。沒有明確目的和緊迫感。

exercises.original: The guide told us to rush because the storm was moving closer.
exercises.zh: 導遊叫我們趕快，因為暴風雨正在逼近。
exercises.upgrade: make haste · 趕快；速速行動（較正式／傳統）

options.explanation: rest = 休息。和 approaching storm 不符。
make haste = 趕快。直接表達急迫地加快行動。

exercises.original: They rushed toward the shelter as the wind grew stronger.
exercises.zh: 風勢增強時，他們趕快朝避難所前進。
exercises.upgrade: made haste · 趕快；速速行動（較正式／傳統）

options.explanation: made haste = 趕快。toward the shelter + worsening wind 很符合緊迫語境。
wandered = 漫遊。沒有緊迫目的。

words.note: speed 作動詞時可表示高速移動，尤其常見於車輛、人快速掠過某處或 speed along/down/through。它比 rush 更突出實際移動速度，不一定帶匆忙心理。
words.example: The car sped down the empty road.
words.exampleZh: 汽車在空曠道路上飛快行駛。

exercises.original: The car rushed down the motorway toward the airport.
exercises.zh: 汽車沿高速公路飛快駛向機場。
exercises.upgrade: sped · 快速前進；飛快行駛

options.explanation: rolled slowly = 慢慢行駛。相反。
sped = 飛快行駛。sped down the motorway 是自然搭配。
waited = 等待。無法形容車輛高速前進。

exercises.original: The cyclist rushed along the flat road to catch the group ahead.
exercises.zh: 單車手沿平路快速前進，想追上前面的隊伍。
exercises.upgrade: sped · 快速前進；飛快行駛

options.explanation: wandered = 漫遊。沒有追趕目的。
sped = 快速前進。sped along the road 是自然移動搭配。

exercises.original: The ambulance rushed through the empty streets toward the hospital.
exercises.zh: 救護車飛快穿過空曠街道前往醫院。
exercises.upgrade: sped · 快速前進；飛快行駛

options.explanation: strolled = 散步。不能形容救護車。
sped = 飛快前進。ambulance + through empty streets 是典型高速移動語境。

words.meaning: 猛衝；趕快跑去；迅速前往
words.note: 當 rush 指短距離內突然快速跑去某處，尤其是趕時間、躲雨或短暫離開時，可用 dash。常見於 dash to / dash into / dash across。
words.example: I dashed to the shop before it closed.
words.exampleZh: 我在店關門前趕快跑去。

exercises.original: She rushed across the street before the light changed.
exercises.zh: 她在燈號轉換前迅速穿過馬路。
exercises.upgrade: dashed · 猛衝；趕快跑去；迅速前往

options.explanation: walked = 步行。沒有急促意味。
dashed = 猛衝。across the street before the light changed 是典型短距離快速動作。

exercises.original: I rushed into the café to get out of the sudden rain.
exercises.zh: 突如其來下雨時，我趕快衝進咖啡店避雨。
exercises.upgrade: dashed · 猛衝；趕快跑去；迅速前往

options.explanation: dashed = 衝進去。short urgent movement to shelter 是典型。
paused = 暫停。不是進入咖啡店。
strolled = 悠閒走。和 sudden rain 不符。
wandered = 漫遊。沒有緊急目的。

exercises.original: He rushed to the corner shop during the five-minute break.
exercises.zh: 他趁五分鐘休息時間趕快跑去街角商店。
exercises.upgrade: dashed · 猛衝；趕快跑去；迅速前往

options.explanation: dashed = 趕快跑去。five-minute break 是短時間內快速往返的典型語境。

words.meaning: 飛奔；急速趕往；快速前進
words.note: 當 rush 指以很高速度趕往某地、追趕某人或與時間競賽時，可用 race。常帶強烈的速度感與緊迫感。
words.example: They raced to the airport before the gate closed.
words.exampleZh: 他們在登機閘口關閉前飛奔到機場。

exercises.original: We rushed to the hospital as soon as we received the call.
exercises.zh: 我們一接到電話就急速趕往醫院。
exercises.upgrade: raced · 飛奔；急速趕往；快速前進

options.explanation: waited = 等待。和 as soon as we received the call 相反。
raced = 急速趕往。urgent hospital trip 帶很強的速度與緊迫感。

exercises.original: The children rushed down the hill to reach the playground first.
exercises.zh: 孩子們飛奔下山坡，想第一個到遊樂場。
exercises.upgrade: raced · 飛奔；急速趕往；快速前進

options.explanation: raced = 飛奔。to reach ... first 明確帶競速意味。

exercises.original: She rushed against the clock to finish the report before noon.
exercises.zh: 她和時間競賽，趕在中午前完成報告。
exercises.upgrade: raced · 飛奔；急速趕往；快速前進

options.explanation: raced = 與時間競賽。race against the clock 是固定慣用語。
relaxed = 放鬆。和趕截止時間不符。

words.note: 當 rush 明確指人短距離以最快速度跑動時，可用 sprint。它比 dash 更突出全速跑和體力爆發。
words.example: He sprinted across the platform to catch the train.
words.exampleZh: 他全速跑過月台去趕火車。

exercises.original: He rushed across the platform when he saw the train doors beginning to close.
exercises.zh: 他看到車門開始關閉時，全速跑過月台。
exercises.upgrade: sprinted · 短距離全速跑；衝刺

options.explanation: sprinted = 全速跑。closing train doors + across platform 是典型短距離衝刺。

exercises.original: The player rushed fifty metres to reach the loose ball.
exercises.zh: 球員全速跑了五十米去追那個自由球。
exercises.upgrade: sprinted · 短距離全速跑；衝刺

options.explanation: sprinted = 衝刺。fifty metres + reach the ball 是典型短距離全速跑。

exercises.original: She rushed the final hundred metres to the finish line.
exercises.zh: 她在最後一百米全力衝刺到終點。
exercises.upgrade: sprinted · 短距離全速跑；衝刺

options.explanation: sprinted = 衝刺。final hundred metres to the finish line 是最典型 sprint 語境。

words.note: scurry 指用短而快的步伐急匆匆移動，常帶忙亂、緊張或小型動物般快速移動的感覺。它比 rush 更有畫面感。
words.example: People scurried indoors when the rain began.
words.exampleZh: 一下雨，人們就急匆匆跑進室內。

exercises.original: Office workers rushed back inside when the heavy rain suddenly started.
exercises.zh: 大雨突然開始時，上班族急匆匆跑回室內。
exercises.upgrade: scurried · 急匆匆小跑；匆忙竄動

options.explanation: strolled = 悠閒走。和 sudden heavy rain 不符。
scurried = 急匆匆小跑。people moving quickly for shelter 是典型。
wandered = 漫遊。沒有緊張忙亂感。

exercises.original: The mice rushed across the floor when the light came on.
exercises.zh: 燈一亮，老鼠就急速竄過地板。
exercises.upgrade: scurried · 急匆匆小跑；匆忙竄動

options.explanation: strolled = 悠閒走。無法形容老鼠驚跑。
scurried = 急速竄動。mice + sudden light 是非常典型。

exercises.original: Staff rushed around the office preparing for the unexpected inspection.
exercises.zh: 員工為突如其來的檢查在辦公室裡急匆匆忙碌。
exercises.upgrade: scurried · 急匆匆小跑；匆忙竄動

options.explanation: scurried = 急匆匆忙碌。unexpected inspection + around the office 很有忙亂感。

words.meaning: 飛奔；疾馳；飛快移動（口語）
words.note: tear 作動詞時可非正式地表示以很快速度移動，常見 tear down / along / through / off。語氣比 rush 更生動、更口語。
words.example: The motorcycle tore down the road.
words.exampleZh: 電單車沿道路疾馳而去。

exercises.original: The motorbike rushed down the road and disappeared around the corner.
exercises.zh: 電單車沿路疾馳，很快消失在轉角後。
exercises.upgrade: tore · 飛奔；疾馳；飛快移動（口語）

options.explanation: strolled = 散步。不能形容電單車。
tore = 疾馳。tear down the road 是非常自然的非正式高速移動表達。

exercises.original: The dog rushed across the field after the ball.
exercises.zh: 狗為了追球飛快跑過草地。
exercises.upgrade: tore · 飛奔；疾馳；飛快移動（口語）

options.explanation: tore = 飛奔。tear across the field 很生動地表達快速追逐。

exercises.original: He rushed off as soon as the meeting ended because he was late for another appointment.
exercises.zh: 會議一結束，他因為下一個約會已遲到，便飛快離開。
exercises.upgrade: tore · 飛奔；疾馳；飛快移動（口語）

options.explanation: tore = 飛快離開。tear off 是自然口語，late for another appointment 強化速度感。
wandered = 漫遊。沒有目的與急迫感。

words.note: 當 rush 指把工作、閱讀、決定或過程做得太快，常因此缺乏仔細考慮時，hurry through 是非常自然的片語。它比單純 hurry 更聚焦『匆忙完成某件事』。
words.example: Don't hurry through the final checks.
words.exampleZh: 不要匆忙做完最後檢查。

exercises.original: Don't rush the final review just because the deadline is close.
exercises.zh: 不要因為截止時間接近就草草完成最後審查。
exercises.upgrade: hurry through · 匆忙做完；草草完成

options.explanation: skip = 跳過。比 rush 更強，表示完全不做。
repeat = 重複。不是速度問題。
hurry through = 匆忙完成。deadline pressure + final review 是典型。

exercises.original: She rushed the instructions and missed an important warning.
exercises.zh: 她匆忙看完指示，結果漏掉了一個重要警告。
exercises.upgrade: hurry through · 匆忙做完；草草完成

options.explanation: studied carefully = 仔細研究。和 missed warning 的匆忙語境相反。
ignored completely = 完全忽略。她有看，只是看得太快。
hurry through = 匆忙看完。missed an important warning 是典型後果。

exercises.original: He rushed the paperwork and made several avoidable mistakes.
exercises.zh: 他草草處理文書工作，結果犯了幾個可避免的錯誤。
exercises.upgrade: hurry through · 匆忙做完；草草完成

options.explanation: checked carefully = 仔細檢查。和 avoidable mistakes 不符。
hurry through = 草草完成。paperwork + mistakes 是典型匆忙處理後果。
reviewed twice = 檢查兩次。相反。

falseSynonyms.zh: 跑不等於一般的 rush run 只描述移動方式，可以慢跑也可以快跑；rush 還包含緊迫、匆忙或急速前往，因此不能一般互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Running is a mode of movement; rushing adds urgency or haste.

falseSynonyms.zh: 恐慌不等於一般的 rush panic 是情緒狀態。人可能因 panic 而 rush，但 rushing 不一定表示恐慌。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Panic can cause rushing, but it is not the same action.

falseSynonyms.zh: 推；催促不等於一般的 rush push 可表示推動、施壓或促進進度，但不是一般的『趕快移動／匆忙做』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Pushing may speed something up, but it is not a general synonym for rush.

falseSynonyms.zh: 強迫；用力不等於一般的 rush force 強調施加力量或迫使某人做事。rush 本身不一定涉及強迫。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Force concerns compulsion; rush concerns haste or speed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 跳過不等於一般的 rush skip 是省略某一步；rush through 是做得太快但仍然做了，兩者不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Skipping omits a step; rushing does it too quickly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 恐慌搶購不等於一般的 rush panic-buy 是非常特定的購買行為，只是某些 rush 情境中的一種結果，不是 rush 的一般同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Panic-buying is a specific behavior, not a general synonym.

falseSynonyms.zh: 加速不等於一般的 rush accelerate 表示速度增加，常用於車輛、過程或增長；它不包含 rush 的匆忙、趕時間語氣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Acceleration is an increase in speed; rushing adds haste or urgency.

falseSynonyms.zh: 猛衝；衝鋒不等於一般的 rush charge 有時可表示猛衝向前，但常帶力量、攻擊性或正面衝撞意味，因此不能一般替代 rush。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Charge is a forceful forward rush, often more aggressive than rush.
